Pick the syndrome, answer a few questions, and it shows the first choice, alternatives, dose, route and duration along with the source section. Renal doses come from the product label; the summary prints or saves as PDF. Preview release for Windows, Android later.

summary.en: A process monitor for Windows, Linux and macOS that quietly records process behaviour and turns it into an evidence file you can hand to an AI. It listens for a chosen period, does the heavy correlation on the device, removes low-value noise and writes the evidence to disk, so a question about a suspicious process gets a real record instead of guesses. It installs with one command and needs no .NET; run as administrator on Windows it also adds network byte counts. For curious users and security people.

summary.en: An adaptive spaced-repetition engine that turns a book or PDF into a question module and drills it until it sticks. Each question first appears without options so you think before choosing; a wrong pick drops that option and shows an explanation written for that specific mistake. When a question closes, the solution plays back with its source file, pages and quoted passage. Scheduling runs on FSRS-6 and understood questions retire. A desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux; question banks are separate, only a small sample ships.

Soru kapanınca çözüm kaynağıyla, yani dosya, sayfa ve alıntılanan pasajla birlikte oynatılır. Zamanlama FSRS-6 ile yapılır, anlaşılan sorular emekliye ayrılır.
